scope_guards: The historical brownfield-land entity is explicitly out of date and marked Development complete.
The 2019 end date is retained and the 2024 entry date does not reactivate the scheme.
The current brownfield-site multipolygon is a Planning Data geography record, not HMLR title geometry.
The current geography record contains no dwelling capacity and does not inherit eight homes as a new current opportunity.
Ilchester and Fitzstephen were separate eight-home applications and are not combined into sixteen homes for LBBD23.
The 2016 permission is a historical event and not a new 2026 permission.
Public-authority ownership in the historical record is not current proprietor proof.
Completed/stale status prevents active-growth promotion even though historical provenance is well supported.
